That's week one of our 90-day plan. This clip is from weeks 9 and 10, which is where a lot of rollouts stall. The team produces more, nobody checks whether the extra output is working, and six months in nobody can say if it's paying off.

The fix is one dashboard and a weekly cadence, with every piece tagged by the workflow that made it, by topic and by format. The model summarises what's working each week. A senior person reads that and decides what to change.

clips.linkedin:
Give AI your team survey and software spend, and it hands back a one-page picture of your AI use.

Plenty of marketing teams using AI can't say what for, who's paying for it, or whether it's working. The first fortnight of our 90-day plan is an audit to find out.

What comes back is who's using what, what it costs and the pain points that come up most. Give it your brand voice doc too, and it tells you whether you could actually prompt from it.

The second job is the first draft of the voice prompt. Give it three pieces you're proud of and three that missed, and it lays out the examples, bans and patterns. Your senior writer still owns it.

The podcast voices are AI-generated. The prompts, the episode and the full plan are at https://manual-focus.co.uk/blog/the-90-day-ai-integration-plan/
clips.text: Get AI on the week-one audit. Give it your team survey responses and your software spend, and it hands back the one-page picture: who's using what, what it costs, and the pain points that come up most. Then give it your voice doc and it tells you whether you could actually prompt from it, and what's missing. Second. Get your AI to draft the first version of the voice prompt. Give it three pieces you're proud of and three that missed, and it drafts the prompt with the examples, bans and patterns laid out. Your senior writer still owns it and does the iterating. The AI just saves them the blank page.
